title.en: Tale 1 — The Donkey and the Neighbour

book_meta.author: traditional
book_meta.status: public domain — folk material, no known author

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: Juha had one donkey in the yard.

sentences.ar: החמור היה זקן אבל עוד עבד.
sentences.en: The donkey was old but still worked.
One morning the neighbour knocked at the door.
Juha opened and said: good morning.

sentences.ar: השכן אמר: אני צריך את החמור.
sentences.en: The neighbour said: I need the donkey.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: רק ליום אחד, לשוק.
sentences.en: He said: only for one day, to the market.

sentences.ar: ג'וחא לא רצה לתת לו אותו.
sentences.en: Juha did not want to give it to him.
He said: I am very sorry.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: החמור לא בבית היום.
sentences.en: He said: the donkey is not at home today.
At that moment a sound was heard from the yard.
The donkey cried out very loudly.
The neighbour looked at Juha quietly.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: אני שומע אותו עכשיו.
sentences.en: He said: I hear it now.
Juha stood a moment and did not move.

sentences.ar: ואז הוא אמר: אני לא מבין אותך.
sentences.en: And then he said: I do not understand you.
He said: I am a grown man.
He said: and you believe a donkey.

sentences.ar: הוא סגר את הדלת ואז נכנס.
sentences.en: He closed the door and went in.
